svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Two Bloch spheres of the same size. Left, the lab frame: the amber path leaves the north pole and spirals down around the violet vertical z axis, turn after turn, until it reaches the equator. Right, the rotating frame: during the same pulse the amber state only runs down one meridian from the north pole to the equator, sweeping a magenta quarter-disc sector, about the violet horizontal X axis. The real pulse holds 125 carrier cycles; the picture draws only 6.
